label: SIMULATION
channel_order_note: Coordinates are stored as H0, H1, H2, H3. Those channels are the requested H1, H2, H3, H4 in that order.
source_position_dataset: generate_source_positions, seed 20261004, 100 sources, range 2–8 m, elevation −50° to 50°, azimuth 0–360°. The draw does not depend on geometry.
z_offset_note: z_offset_m is the H3 height above the H0/H1/H2 centroid before the four-phone centroid is shifted to the origin. make_three_plus_one(-z_offset_m) mirrors this array.
noise_model: SNR_dB = 10*log10(P_chirp / P_noise); independent Gaussian noise on each hydrophone; seed = random_seed + trial_index, shared across SNR and geometry
